claim: Physical objects continue to exist when not being observed — their properties persist independent of measurement

evidence.title: Object Permanence in Infants (Baillargeon 1985)
evidence.finding: Infants as young as 5 months show surprise when objects violate permanence, indicating innate expectation that objects persist

evidence.title: Scientific Realism (SEP)
evidence.finding: Scientific realism holds that the objects described by successful theories exist independently of our awareness of them

scoreReasoning.correspondence: Directly confirmed by every repeatable experiment — objects measured at t1 are found at t2 with consistent properties
scoreReasoning.coherence: Foundational assumption of all physics, chemistry, and engineering
scoreReasoning.convergence: Universal assumption across all sciences; quantum measurement debate is about information, not macro-object persistence
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: All technology depends on objects persisting — bridges, computers, medicine

claim: Physical reality has three spatial dimensions and one temporal dimension forming a continuous spacetime manifold

evidence.title: Die Grundlage der allgemeinen Relativitaetstheorie (Einstein 1916)
evidence.finding: General relativity describes gravity as curvature of 4-dimensional spacetime, confirmed by gravitational lensing, GPS corrections, and gravitational waves

evidence.title: The Dimensionality of Space (SEP)
evidence.finding: Ehrenfest (1917) showed that stable orbits and atomic structure require exactly 3 spatial dimensions; confirmed by all observations

scoreReasoning.correspondence: 3+1 dimensions directly measured by every physics experiment; GPS requires relativistic spacetime corrections accurate to nanoseconds
scoreReasoning.coherence: Foundation of general relativity, quantum field theory, and all of modern physics
scoreReasoning.convergence: All observations consistent with 3+1 dimensions; string theory proposes extra compactified dimensions but these are unobserved
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: Navigation, engineering, particle physics, cosmology all operate in 3+1 dimensional spacetime

claim: Effects follow causes in a lawful, time-ordered manner — causes temporally precede or coincide with their effects

evidence.title: Causation in Physics (SEP)
evidence.finding: Causal structure is built into the light-cone structure of relativistic spacetime — causes must be in the past light cone of effects

evidence.title: Experimental Realization of Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen-Bohm Gedankenexperiment (Aspect 1982)
evidence.finding: Bell test experiments confirm quantum correlations but do not enable faster-than-light signaling, preserving causal ordering

scoreReasoning.correspondence: Causal ordering is directly observable in every experiment; no verified case of retrocausation exists
scoreReasoning.coherence: Built into the structure of relativity (light cones) and thermodynamics (arrow of time)
scoreReasoning.convergence: Universal assumption in physics; quantum entanglement raised questions but does not violate signal causality
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: All engineering, medicine, and technology depend on reliable cause-effect relationships

claim: The laws of physics are the same at all places and times — physical law is spatiotemporally universal

evidence.title: The Constants of Nature (Uzan 2003)
evidence.finding: Observations of distant quasars, nuclear reactors (Oklo), and Big Bang nucleosynthesis constrain variation in fundamental constants to parts per billion over cosmic time

evidence.title: Symmetry and Symmetry Breaking (SEP)
evidence.finding: Noether's theorem proves that conservation laws follow from spacetime symmetries — if laws are uniform, energy and momentum are conserved

scoreReasoning.correspondence: Spectral lines from galaxies billions of light-years away match laboratory physics; fundamental constants tested to extraordinary precision
scoreReasoning.coherence: Noether's theorem formally connects uniformity to conservation laws; foundational to cosmology
scoreReasoning.convergence: Broad agreement; some speculative models allow slow cosmological variation but no variation detected
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: All of science depends on the assumption that experiments done here and now apply universally

claim: Fundamental quantities (energy, momentum, angular momentum, electric charge) are conserved in all physical interactions

evidence.title: Invariante Variationsprobleme (Noether 1918)
evidence.finding: Noether proved that every continuous symmetry of a physical system corresponds to a conserved quantity — time symmetry gives energy conservation, spatial symmetry gives momentum conservation

evidence.title: Conservation Law Tests at CERN
evidence.finding: Particle physics experiments at CERN confirm conservation of energy, momentum, charge, and lepton/baryon number to extraordinary precision

scoreReasoning.correspondence: Conservation laws are among the most precisely tested statements in all of science — verified to parts per trillion
scoreReasoning.coherence: Proven by Noether's theorem to follow from spacetime symmetries; central to all of physics
scoreReasoning.convergence: No known violation of energy, momentum, or charge conservation; universal agreement
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: All engineering, power generation, chemistry, and technology depend on conservation laws

claim: Physical laws can be reliably discovered through systematic observation, mathematical formalization, and experimental testing

evidence.title: Scientific Discovery (SEP)
evidence.finding: The history of physics shows a reliable pattern: observation → mathematical law → prediction → confirmation

evidence.title: The discovery of the Higgs boson (Nature 2015)
evidence.finding: The Higgs boson was predicted mathematically in 1964 and confirmed experimentally in 2012, demonstrating the power of mathematical physics to discover real entities

scoreReasoning.correspondence: The track record of physics (Maxwell → radio waves, Einstein → gravitational waves, Higgs prediction → discovery) provides strong meta-evidence
scoreReasoning.coherence: Consistent with the entire scientific enterprise and philosophy of science
scoreReasoning.convergence: Broad agreement that physics discovers real laws; debate about whether laws are 'discovered' or 'constructed'
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: Technology based on discovered physical laws works — semiconductors, nuclear energy, GPS, MRI

claim: The physical universe has a consistent, observer-independent structure governed by discoverable, universal laws

evidence.title: Scientific Realism (SEP)
evidence.finding: The no-miracles argument: the success of science would be miraculous if theories didn't approximately describe reality

evidence.title: Structural Realism (SEP)
evidence.finding: Even across theory change, the mathematical structure of successful theories is preserved, suggesting it reflects real structure in the world

scoreReasoning.correspondence: The meta-claim integrates empirical and philosophical elements — cannot be directly measured as a single proposition
scoreReasoning.coherence: Synthesizes object permanence, spacetime structure, causality, uniformity, and conservation into a unified picture
scoreReasoning.convergence: Mainstream position in physics and philosophy of science; challenged by constructivists and some interpretations of QM
scoreReasoning.pragmatism: The entire technological civilization is evidence that physical reality has discoverable structure
